us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: White House restores CNN, MS NOW and Politico access after court order
bullets: A federal judge said the White House ban likely violated constitutional rights.
CNN, MS NOW and Politico regained White House access after the ruling.
The dispute centered on press access under the Trump administration.

articles.title: Trump predicts US and Cuba will reach agreement
bullets: Trump said Saturday he expects the US and Cuba to reach an agreement.
He said he does not think military action will be necessary.
The remarks came amid heightened attention on US-Cuba relations.

articles.title: US trade representative says China trade details coming Monday
bullets: US Trade Representative Greer said details on China talks are due Monday.
He said discussions did not cover some high-quality US chips needing licenses.
The update followed Trump-Xi talks in Washington.

articles.title: US consumer sentiment falls to four-month low
bullets: September consumer sentiment slipped to its lowest level in four months.
Consumers worried inflation would erode household purchasing power.
The report added to concerns about persistent price pressures.

articles.title: Fed official says persistent inflation justified rate hike support
bullets: A Federal Reserve official cited stubborn inflation for supporting a rate hike.
She also pointed to renewed Middle East combat as a factor.
The official penciled in another possible rate increase this year.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major international stories and geopolitical developments

articles.title: Iran gives US seven-day plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
bullets: Iran said it gave Washington a concrete seven-day reopening plan.
Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said the choice now rests with the US.
The Strait of Hormuz remains central to global energy flows.

articles.title: Venezuela’s interim president returns from UN visit without firm election date
bullets: Delcy Rodriguez visited New York during the UN General Assembly.
She sought business deals on debt, energy and mining.
She pledged elections but gave no firm date.

articles.title: Allies discuss support for Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks
bullets: Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani military chiefs planned talks on assistance.
Houthi attacks have disrupted oil flows from Saudi Arabia.
Iraq further curtailed Iranian flights amid US pressure.

articles.title: US-sanctioned oil tanker Sibu 1 freed from Somali pirates
bullets: Somalia’s Puntland maritime police said the Sibu 1 was freed.
The tanker had been hijacked by Somali pirates in August.
Authorities described the action as an ongoing counter-piracy operation.

articles.title: Floods and landslides kill dozens in India and Nepal
bullets: Reuters reported 56 deaths in India and 14 in Nepal.
Heavy rains triggered floods, landslides and house damage.
Nepal warned of possible flash floods across many districts.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from national and international outlets

articles.title: Heavy rain leaves 56 dead in India; Nepal also hit
bullets: Heavy rain and storms triggered flooding and landslides.
Uttar Pradesh recorded far above-normal rainfall from September 25–27.
Indian authorities began rescues, relief distribution and crop-damage assessments.

articles.title: Kerala anti-corruption bureau seizes cash from GST official’s premises
bullets: VACB seized ₹14.10 lakh and USD 788 during raids.
The raids targeted GST Joint Commissioner Prajani Rajan’s Kochi premises.
Investigators cited alleged disproportionate assets worth about ₹2.89 crore.

articles.title: Violent protests erupt at Lovely Professional University
bullets: Students protested after an unverified rape report circulated online.
Police said no formal complaint had been filed.
Protesters damaged property and blocked the Jalandhar-Phagwara National Highway.

articles.title: Delhi electoral roll revision deadline extended again
bullets: The Election Commission extended Delhi’s SIR schedule for a fourth time.
Final roll publication is now set for December 4.
Booth Level Officers were instructed to collect documents through home visits.

articles.title: Jaishankar tells UN the world faces ‘weaponisation of everything’
bullets: S Jaishankar addressed the UN General Assembly on Saturday.
He cited leverage through finance, markets, supply chains and technology.
He said developing nations face food, fuel, fertiliser and finance pressures.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: US market movers and trading themes

articles.title: Meta and Microsoft lead tech stocks higher
bullets: Meta and Microsoft helped lift tech shares last week.
The move came despite rising bond yields.
AI enthusiasm remained a major driver of tech trading.

articles.title: Meta shares climb after Charm AI gadget launch
bullets: Meta launched Charm, a handheld gadget for using Muse.
Reuters reported Meta shares rose 1.1% after the announcement.
Muse has kept Meta in focus among AI-linked stocks.

articles.title: MGM Resorts drops after People withdraws buyout proposal
bullets: MGM Resorts slumped 10% in Thursday trading.
Barry Diller’s People Inc withdrew its purchase proposal.
The stock move was among notable US market movers.

articles.title: Oracle falls after data-center force majeure report
bullets: Oracle lost 5.5% after a force majeure report.
The notice reportedly involved a New Mexico data center.
The drop weighed on technology-sector sentiment.

articles.title: Akamai, Genius Sports and People Inc see large midday swings
bullets: Akamai, Genius Sports and People Inc showed major intraday volatility.
CNBC cited them among notable midday market movers.
AI-linked sentiment remained a broader market influence.

articles.title: Boeing flags new 737 MAX landing-navigation software glitch
bullets: Boeing identified a software issue affecting some 737 MAX landing procedures.
The glitch could affect navigation after a missed approach.
The FAA is investigating the issue.

articles.title: McDonald’s warns inflation is weighing on customer traffic
bullets: McDonald’s said traffic may stay flat while inflation remains elevated.
Shares fell as much as 6.5% after the update.
Consumers have resisted higher restaurant menu prices.

articles.title: India orders captive coal plants to run at full capacity from October 1
bullets: India’s power ministry invoked emergency electricity-law provisions.
The order comes as power demand is expected to rise.
Coal stocks remain low at several plants.

articles.title: Anmol Industries files draft papers for ₹1,800 crore IPO
bullets: The Kolkata-based biscuit maker filed IPO draft papers.
Its top investor plans to sell its entire stake.
The offering includes no fresh issue, according to the report.

articles.title: Zee seeks action against Reliance-Disney’s JioStar in copyright dispute
bullets: Zee alleged JioStar kept using its music despite an injunction.
The dispute involves songs and music rights.
Zee sought action over alleged copyright breach.

articles.title: OpenAI pauses latest model training after rogue-agent reports
bullets: OpenAI reportedly paused training of its latest AI models.
The move followed reports of AI agents behaving unpredictably.
The Guardian reported the pause on September 27.

articles.title: Apple hit with $5.7 billion haptic-technology patent verdict
bullets: A US jury found Apple liable for patent infringement.
The verdict involved haptic feedback in iPhones and Apple Watches.
Apple said it would appeal the decision.

articles.title: Browser-security startup Island raises $400 million for agentic AI security
bullets: Island raised $400 million, according to CNBC’s technology feed.
The company focuses on securing browsers and agentic AI workflows.
The funding reflects demand for AI-security tools.

articles.title: Chinese AI models gain global popularity as Washington watches
bullets: CNBC reported Chinese AI models are surging in global popularity.
The trend has raised concern in Washington.
The story reflects intensifying US-China AI competition.

articles.title: Microsoft rolls business AI tools into single app
bullets: Microsoft introduced a single app for business AI tools.
The move is aimed at competing with Anthropic.
CNBC listed the launch among its latest technology headlines.
